description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition class, which specifies the allowed HTML elements, attributes, transformations, and other structural aspects for an HTML purification library. It includes methods for customizing the HTML Definition, processing modules, and setup configurations, and describes its internal variables and setup procedures.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: Defines the structure and rules for allowed HTML elements and attributes used in HTML sanitization, including methods for modification and setup based on configuration.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a custom attribute to a specified existing element within the HTML definition.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new element to the HTML definition with specified type, contents, attributes, and collections.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Adds a placeholder (blank) element to override or define new behavior.

methods.name: getAnonymousModule
methods.description: Retrieves an internal anonymous module for advanced modifications.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs initial setup and processing of modules with a given configuration.

methods.name: processModules
methods.description: Extracts information from modules and updates internal structures accordingly.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Configures the HTML definition based on specific configuration options, including allowed/disallowed elements and attributes.

methods.name: parseTinyMCEAllowedList
methods.description: Parses a TinyMCE-format string list of allowed elements and attributes into structured arrays.
